description: One run of the spec's suite fragment with every row recorded. Every DRIVEN row applies a mutation to a copy (of the engine's .veldo/*.py or of .veldo/policy_contract.py), runs the same harness and requires the named row red while the unmutated copy passes it; the fixture trees carry a copy of the engine so each adapter runs from its own root.
driven_rows: VELDO-0016 AC3 policy-loading/unreadable DRIVEN (the declared falsifier): mapping an unreadable present contract to optional absence turns the unreadable row RED for the loader and for every adapter without a presence guard of its own under the optional flag (16 of 34 rows red; guarded: ['metrics_shape_readers._read_contract'])
VELDO-0016 AC3 policy-loading/malformed DRIVEN: the pre-fix handler that returned (None, None) for a malformed present file turns the malformed row RED for every adapter (16 of 17 rows red)

VELDO-0016 AC3 policy-loading/absent/required DRIVEN: a dead required flag turns the required-absence row RED for every adapter, the presence-guarded one included, because absence is the one state a boundary's kind question cannot see (17 of 17 rows red)

VELDO-0016 AC1 policy-activation/draft DRIVEN (the declared falsifier): with the draft refusal removed, the draft process decision VELDO-DEC-0004 is no longer refused as draft (it now falls to 'undecided_by_a_person': VELDO-DEC-0004 is decided but names no decider: only a person decides, on the re), so the policy-activation/draft row reds; unmutated it refuses as draft
VELDO-0016 AC1 policy-activation/stale DRIVEN: with the version check removed a re-decided record at version 2 activates, so the stale row reds; unmutated it refuses as stale

VELDO-0016 AC1 policy-activation/under_reviewed DRIVEN: with the review count check removed a decided critical record with one bound review of the two required activates, so the row reds; unmutated it refuses as under_reviewed

VELDO-0016 AC2 policy-activation/retirement-obligation DRIVEN (the declared falsifier): with the empty-containment proof removed from the retirement predicate, a slot with unproven emptiness is released, so the row reds; unmutated it is refused by name

VELDO-0016 AC4 policy-boundaries/review-is-not-authority DRIVEN (the declared falsifier): with a passing verdict treated as authorization, the seeded receipt lands, so the row reds; unmutated it is refused
